scope: Independent read-only collector, verifier, restorer and bounded ignored-context finalizer source review. No collector, product tests/build/browser, live provider or remote writes run by this reviewer.

initialCandidate.qualification: Historical initial candidate; exact current file hashes above include the reviewed follow-ups.

responsibilitiesReviewed.assessment: Discovers all registered in-workspace Git worktrees; captures tracked/untracked current files, outputs and every additional ignored file/root except explicit runtime/build/auth/handover exclusions. Missing tracked paths, binary diffs, index and exact working metadata are retained. Source capture uses exact bytes, modes and filesystem identities, with source/selection/Git stability checks. Excluded untracked handover status changes do not weaken HEAD/index/diff or selected-byte checks.

Manifest canonical JSON and an optional trusted external hash bind metadata and compressed packs; exact named regular blob member inventory, uncompressed hashes/sizes, gzip integrity and recorded counts are verified. Unsafe paths, duplicate keys, file/parent collisions, private Git paths, arbitrary archive member destinations and missing/unreferenced blobs are refused.

An explicit new absolute target is required. The full package is verified before creation; regular files are created exclusively and rehashed, source modes are recorded and only ordinary rwx bits restored. Symlinks require opt-in, are validated for lexical containment and chained/self references, and are written last. Metadata and final manifest/checksum copies are bound to verified bytes; partial failures retain diagnosis without overwriting existing user files.

Scans each distinct source payload plus ordinary nested ZIP/gzip/tar contents, records format/context candidates without printing matched values, and records encrypted/unreadable/budget coverage limits. It does not silently redact or publish and does not claim guaranteed absence of credentials; final disposition belongs to root.

The initial WIP manifest is retained byte-exact as gzip metadata; existing packs are hash-checked and remain unchanged. Additional ignored context is captured under a second explicit stability boundary, new packs append with exclusive creation, and the primary history reference is replaced with the separately qualified base-dependent bundle while preserving its historical predecessor. Final complete package verification remains required.
